chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Faraj, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) wrote to me: “When Allah, Blessed and Exalted, becomes wrathful with His creation, He removes us from their vicinity.”

key_terms.نَحَّانَا: He distanced us or moved us away

ai.seo_question: What does the saying of Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) mean about Allah distancing the Ahl al-Bayt from people when He is wrathful?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when Allah, Blessed and Exalted, is wrathful toward the creation, the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام) are distanced from among them. It points to the theological significance of the presence of the Imam as a mercy and protection, and his removal as a sign of divine displeasure.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Al Faraj who said,

‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> wrote to me: ‘Whenever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High is Wrathful upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, He<sup>azwj</sup> Forbids us<sup>asws</sup> from being in their vicinity’.
en.sarwar: 31. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah from Muhammad ibn al-Faraj who has said the following.
“Abu Ja’far (a.s.) wrote to me, ‘when Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, is angry with His creatures He keeps us away from their neighborhood.”
